location.section: What we have learned so far

old_text: In iteration 5, 130 correct programs outside the catalogue, from the base model, the transplant, the panels, the knobs and Gemma, were all labeller misses, known techniques outside the frozen catalogue, catalogue variants or degenerate.
new_text: In iteration 5, 130 correct programs outside the catalogue, from the base model, the transplant, the panels, the knobs and Gemma, were all labeller misses, known techniques outside the frozen catalogue, catalogue variants or degenerate. A second blind adjudication in iteration 6 re-read the 14 transplant programs that two of three judges had called novel (judges 14 of 48, manual 0, second adjudication 1 of 14 (Mistral Medium 3.1, three calls at temperature 0, control gate 9 of 10, passed; Kimi K2 second view 0 of 14), final count after the executor's full read 0; the contested control, repeated maximum selection for top-k frequent, which the iteration-5 manual pass itself classed as a catalogue variant, was called catalogue variant by Mistral and catalogue variant by Kimi (Mistral gate 10 of 10 under that convention); the final read corrects 1 manual class (CATALOGUE VARIANT to DEGENERATE), none to novel). Each program was stress-tested in a sandbox at the specification's maximum size and on adversarial cases, shown with its three nearest known solutions by tree edit distance, and judged by model families the run had not used, with ten blinded controls of known class; raw agreement with the manual verdict on the 14 was 0.86 (95% 0.57 to 0.98), Gwet's AC1 0.83; Cohen's kappa on novel against not novel is 0 by construction against a constant reference (iteration-6 correction; tables/novelty_readjudication.csv). The novel calls, each read in full: P13 (R6; 3 of 3 Mistral calls; technique named by the judge: 'none', reason: 'Uses linear search with early termination, not a known efficient technique for sorted arrays.'; hidden tests 56 of 56, stress groups all pass; final read: range guards plus a linear scan to the first match and over its run: linear search).
